decisions.reason: As a combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot that directly extends the firm's established automation, formwork and control know-how, it fits the firm's strong absorptive capacity and is likely to be refined rather than withdrawn.

The automatic de-shuttering robot is close to the firm's core plant and process expertise, so management can learn from early customer use and improve it, although some overlap with broader robotic solutions raises a modest risk.

The profile storage robot still builds on the firm's existing production-system knowledge and broad offering, but as a somewhat more specialized module it faces slightly higher risk if adoption proves narrower than expected.

The automatic shuttering robot is well aligned with the firm's long-standing capabilities in precast production automation and should benefit from in-house R&D and system integration, making continuation more likely than exit.
